tools.name: preview_product
tools.description:
Preview one product: metadata, persona teaser, and paid-skill teasers. FREE.

Typical input {"slug": "inbox-commander"} returns {"slug": ...,
"name": ..., "tagline": ..., "persona_preview": ..., "skills":
[{"name": ..., "preview": ...}], "free_skill": ..., "note": ...}.

Returns teasers only, never

tools.name: get_free_skill
tools.description:
Load a product's free gateway skill with its complete instructions. FREE.

Typical input {"slug": "inbox-commander"} returns {"slug": ...,
"skill": "<skill name>", "instructions": "<full skill text>"}.

Returns exactly one skill - the product's free gateway skill - chosen
automatically from the slug

tools.name: list_kits
tools.description:
List the 12 themed kits with pricing and member products. FREE.

Takes no arguments. Returns a list of kit objects, each {"slug": ...,
"name": ..., "price_usd": N, "tagline": ..., "members": ["product-slug",
...], "availability": ...}. Use a kit's slug with get_full_kit (premium).
Kits are not sold

tools.name: upgrade_info
tools.description:
Explain how to unlock full personas, paid skills, and kits. FREE.

Takes no arguments. Returns {"message": ..., "how": ..., "free_tier":
...} describing the upgrade path and what stays free.

Use when a premium tool has been refused or the caller asks what a plan
covers. Not for per-bundle or per-pr

Returns the persona text alone, with no skill bodies. Use when the caller

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "catalog" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, preview_product, get_free_skill, upgrade_info, get_full_persona, get_full_skill, get_full_product, recommend_products · Public sink: search_catalog, get_full_skill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, preview_product, get_free_skill, upgrade_info, get_full_persona, get_full_skill, get_full_product, recommend_products · Public sink: search_catalog, get_full_skill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "preview_product" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
